protocol.frame: x forward, y left, z up; positive yaw CCW/nose left
protocol.objective: 0.5 * sum(((achieved-requested)/wrench_scale)^2); scales are explicit illustrative allocation priorities
protocol.numerical_tolerance_provenance: Gradient mapping tolerance 1e-5 explicitly accommodates float32 publication; it is distinct from the dimensionless independent objective-gap cutoff 1e-4. These numerical settings are not physical coefficients.
protocol.provenance: Arbitrary synthetic geometry, CG, thrust coefficients and limits. No aircraft fit, measured travel calibration, thrust test, flight envelope or real-time performance qualification.

units.tail_direction: mathematical effort direction in rad, not a calibrated mechanical angle

direct_effectiveness.provenance: Arbitrary synthetic effectiveness map, never fitted to aircraft logs. This configuration requires no rotor positions, CG, mass, inertia, kT or force/moment calibration.

protocol.validation_boundary: Offline static geometric allocation only. Sweep index is a synthetic sequence of static requests, not elapsed time or servo dynamics. Tail angle is an assumed synthetic input, not derived from servo PWM or ADC counts. Known reaction yaw is exogenous and applied once; no coupled kQ/J allocation, gyroscopic model, PID, mixer or actuator integration.

units.tail_direction: mathematical effort direction in rad, not a calibrated mechanical angle

synthetic_identification_demo.scope: Algebraic demo in the declared global virtual-tail basis; no aircraft logs or local motor/servo Jacobian fit

held_angle_demo.scope: Same thrusts, different independently supplied angle. No angle inferred from PWM/ADC; no servo response simulated.
